output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial totalSupply is set to 0, and anyone can exploit this vulnerability to mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any user's balanceOf[target] due to the initial unprotected minting function.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the balanceOf[_to] to overflow and become a very large number, and the owner to lose funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the balanceOf[_to] to overflow and become a very large number, and the owner to lose funds.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the allowance[msg.sender][_spender] + _value is greater than the maximum uint256, allowing the allowance to overflow and become a very large number, and the owner to lose funds.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_from] >= _value, allowing the balanceOf[_from] to overflow and become a very large number, and the owner to lose funds.
